annotations.title: Check a product page for AI readability

description: Audit a single product page for how well AI shopping assistants can read and recommend it. Takes the product page URL and returns a 0-100 score with findings on structured data (Product/Offer schema), price and availability markup, images, description quality and identifiers such as GTIN and brand. Use this for questions like "why does ChatGPT not recommend this product", or when reviewing one specific product listing rather than a whole store. Works on any public product page.

url.description: The full URL of one product page, e.g. "https://example.com/products/blue-shoe".

name: check_product
